title: dm_query_json request
description: A bulk question about the object tree. Frozen at ABI 0.11 and versioned separately from the binary: new queries and new optional members are additive, and anything removed or renamed is a major bump. Unknown members are ignored by the library, so a client written against a later schema still gets an answer from an older build.

path.description: The type path to answer about. "/" and "" both mean the root.

depth.description: objectTree only. Levels of children to include: 1 is one level, which is what a panel needs for a node the user just expanded; 0 is the node alone, for a single-row refresh.

limit.description: subtypesOf only. Cap on how many types come back. A response that hit the cap sets "truncated".

inherited.description: members only. Include what the type inherits, walking parent_type rather than the path.

includeBuiltins.description: Include BYOND's own types and members alongside the project's.
